data.title: Pond Duck Stories

challenges.instruction: Can you build the story for this addition equation? Tap and place the ducks in the pond!
challenges.storyText: 2 ducks are swimming in the pond. 1 more duck joins them.

challenges.instruction: Match this subtraction equation by making some ducks leave the pond.
challenges.storyText: 4 ducks are swimming in the pond. 2 ducks fly away.

challenges.instruction: Set up the pond scene to show this joining story!
challenges.storyText: 1 duck is swimming near the reeds. 3 more ducks swim over to join.

challenges.instruction: Show what happens in this subtraction story by taking ducks away.
challenges.storyText: 5 ducks are swimming in the sunny pond. 4 ducks waddle out.

challenges.instruction: Build this addition story with the ducks in the water!
challenges.storyText: 3 ducks are resting by the water. 2 more ducks arrive.

challenges.instruction: Can you arrange the ducks to match this subtraction equation?
challenges.storyText: 3 ducks are floating peacefully. 1 duck swims away.

challenges.instruction: Place the right number of ducks in the pond for this addition story!
challenges.storyText: 2 ducks are paddling together. 3 more ducks dive in.

data.description: Kindergarten students practice foundational addition and subtraction by creating and matching stories with ducks in a pond.
